'''Rock-A-Bye Pokémon (Part 2)''' (Japanese: '''アーモンドを救え！！ (後編)''' ''Save Almond! (Part 2)''), is the seventh chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey volume 7|seventh volume]] of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hazel]] and [[Coconut]] find that the source of [[Almond]]'s deep sleep is a pair of prankster Pokémon, {{p|Drowzee}} and {{p|Hypno}}. They've put him to sleep and are eating his dreams! What's more, he's having ''romantic'' dreams, and so the two are eating his ''will to love'' as well!
